_note: First-time hints (garage/hints.js): each shown once, the first time what it's about happens (when), where the player is (drive: on the road; garage), and never again (the player's save keeps the ones seen). when — damage: the car's damaged; mechanical: something bent, leaking or worn by a crash; loose: a part hanging loose or torn off; undrivable: it can't carry on racing; replay: a crash replay is playing; damageTab: the garage with a damaged car; safetyNet: the free basic repair is offered; questCard: a quest's card opened; medal: the first results with medals to win; npcRace: the first race against rivals, on the grid; pinkSlip: a pink slip's card; fastTravel: the quest finder on the full map.

hints.title: Your car is damaged
hints.text: Visit the garage to repair it: its Damage tab lists every problem.

hints.title: Something's bent or leaking
hints.text: The dashboard lamps show what's wrong, and I opens the damage report. The garage puts it right.

hints.title: A part's hanging off
hints.text: It drags, and can fall off. The garage bolts it back on — a part torn off comes back with the car.

hints.title: The car can't carry on
hints.text: Tow it to the garage (Backspace, twice) for repairs.

hints.title: Crash replay
hints.text: Any key skips it. Switch replays off in the settings (O).

hints.title: Damage report
hints.text: Every problem and what it does. Click one to see it on the car. A quick repair is cheaper and leaves it at about 80%; a full one makes it as new.

hints.title: Short of money?
hints.text: The workshop will patch your car up just enough to drive, for free: Damage tab.

hints.title: A quest
hints.text: Start pays the entry fee and puts you on the grid. Set route draws the way there on the maps. Harder quests (more stars) pay more.

hints.title: Medals
hints.text: Beat the gold, silver or bronze target for a medal. Your first medal on a quest pays the most; repeats pay less, and much less if you farm one quest.

hints.title: Racing rivals
hints.text: Finish ahead of them: your place sets your medal. The gaps to the cars either side are on the right.

hints.title: Pink slip
hints.text: Winner takes the loser's car — yours too. You'll be asked to confirm before it starts.

hints.title: Finding quests
hints.text: Filter quests here, or try Recommended. Go fast-travels to any quest in a baked region and opens its card when you arrive.
